title: VENSUKO Launcher 0.14.1 - Account Sign-out & Local Library Hotfix
notes:
VENSUKO Launcher 0.14.1 - Account Sign-out & Local Library Hotfix

- Fixed account sign-out by using device-local session removal and displaying any remaining sign-out error directly.
- Cloud synchronization of game libraries, playtime and settings is disabled until VENSUKO 1.0.0 and the dedicated server is operational.
- Removed unfinished Cloud status, Sync now and account cloud-progress panels from the launcher.
- Game library membership, playtime and preferences remain available locally without waiting on cloud database tables.
- Account login, public profiles and Friends remain available through the existing account/social service.
